name: Dumpster Diving
description: Discarded materials from a target organization can yield an extraordinary amount of intelligence — shredded documents, old ID badges, network diagrams, internal memos, access control system documentation, vendor invoices, and physical keys. Dumpster diving is legal in most US jurisdictions once waste has been placed for collection on public property, but always confirm scope with the client and consult local statutes. This technique often produces the most operationally valuable intelligence of any recon method.

blue.det: Individual accessing dumpsters or recycling areas; unsecured documents in waste streams.
blue.cm: Cross-cut or micro-cut shredding of all paper; locked waste containers; clean-desk policy.
